title: RC, Insurance and PUC Document Extraction
summary: Extract and cross-check registration, chassis, owner, hypothecation and validity details from RC, insurance, PUC and fitness documents for used-car, fleet and onboarding teams.

seo.title: RC, Insurance and PUC Document Extraction | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that reads RC, motor insurance, PUC, fitness and permit documents, cross-checks chassis and owner details, and tracks expiry for fleets and dealers.

designed_for: Operations Head at a Mobility Platform

problem.intro: Used-car buyers, fleet operators, rental and subscription companies and ride-hailing platforms check the same vehicle documents again and again: the registration certificate, the motor insurance policy, the PUC certificate and, for commercial vehicles, fitness and permit. Each arrives as a phone photo, a smart-card scan or a DigiLocker PDF, and every detail is re-typed.

pain_points.title: Manual keying of long identifiers
pain_points.detail: Chassis and engine numbers are long and easy to mistype, and one wrong character breaks every later check.

pain_points.title: Many formats for the same document
pain_points.detail: Paper RCs, smart cards and digital RCs differ by state and era, and each insurer lays out its policy schedule differently.

pain_points.title: Expiries that slip
pain_points.detail: Fleet teams lose track of insurance, PUC, fitness and permit renewals across a large and changing fleet.

pain_points.title: Mismatches found late
pain_points.detail: A hypothecation entry, an owner name that differs from the seller or a chassis number that does not match the policy surfaces only at transfer or claim time.

solution.overview: We build a vehicle document pipeline that accepts uploads, WhatsApp photos and, with the owner's consent, DigiLocker documents. Each document is classified, then OCR and a language model extract registration number, chassis and engine numbers, owner name, ownership serial, hypothecation, registration and validity dates, insurer, policy number, cover type and PUC validity. Fields are cross-checked across documents and, where you choose, against registry data through an authorised provider. Mismatches and low-confidence fields go to an operations executive. Clean records flow into your DMS or fleet system, and an expiry calendar sends renewal reminders.
capabilities: Classifies RC, insurance policy schedule, PUC, fitness certificate, permit and driving licence
Extracts registration, chassis, engine, owner, hypothecation and validity details
Cross-checks chassis and registration numbers and owner names across documents
Optional checks against registry data through an authorised VAHAN-based provider
Expiry calendar with renewal reminders for insurance, PUC, fitness and permits
Flags hypothecation, ownership changes and name mismatches for the transfer desk

workflow.title: Receive documents
workflow.detail: Documents arrive by app upload, WhatsApp or consented DigiLocker pull, grouped by vehicle.

workflow.title: Classify and extract
workflow.detail: Each document is classified and its fields extracted with confidence scores and links to the source image.

workflow.title: Cross-check
workflow.detail: Chassis, registration and owner details are compared across documents and, optionally, with registry data.

workflow.title: Review exceptions
workflow.detail: Mismatches and low-confidence fields go to an operations executive for resolution.

workflow.title: Create the vehicle record
workflow.detail: Verified data is written to the DMS, fleet or onboarding system.

workflow.title: Track expiry
workflow.detail: Validity dates feed a calendar that reminds owners and fleet managers before documents lapse.

inputs: Registration certificates in paper, smart card or digital form
Fitness certificates and permits for commercial vehicles
Owner KYC documents, with Aadhaar masked where used
outputs: Verified vehicle record with registration, chassis, engine and owner details
Hypothecation and ownership-change alerts for transfers
human_in_the_loop: Operations executives resolve every mismatch and low-confidence field. Purchase, onboarding and transfer decisions stay with your team; the system never rejects a vehicle or driver on its own.
integrations: Dealer management or fleet management system
guardrails: Aadhaar numbers masked on capture and never stored in full
Registry checks only through authorised channels
No automatic rejection; exceptions go to people
Every field linked to its source image
Document images retained only for the period your policy sets
compliance_notes: Owner and driver details are personal data handled under the DPDP Act 2023; Aadhaar, where collected, is masked and handled per UIDAI rules.
Expiry reminders help owners keep insurance and PUC valid as the Motor Vehicles Act requires; responsibility stays with the vehicle owner.

pilot.scope: One document flow, such as fleet vehicle onboarding or used-car procurement, using a historical sample plus live documents processed in parallel with the current desk.
deliverables: Extraction schemas for RC, insurance and PUC
Cross-check rule set agreed with operations
Accuracy report against manually verified records

what_we_measure.how: Extracted fields compared with records verified by operations staff.
Share of flagged mismatches confirmed as genuine by reviewers.
Time to complete document checks with and without the pipeline.
Documents identified as expired or near expiry that the current process had not flagged.

faqs.q: Do state-wise RC formats cause problems?
faqs.a: No. Extraction reads the content rather than relying on a fixed template, so old paper RCs, smart cards and digital RCs from different states are handled. Unusual formats are flagged for review and added to the test set.

faqs.q: Can it pull documents from DigiLocker?
faqs.a: Yes, with the owner's consent through an approved DigiLocker integration. Issued documents from DigiLocker are cleaner than photos and need less review.
Fields the model cannot read with confidence are flagged, and the owner can be asked on WhatsApp to send a clearer photo of that specific document.

faqs.q: Can it check pending challans or blacklisting?
faqs.a: Where you have access to such data through an authorised provider, the pipeline can call it as an extra check. We do not scrape government portals.
